cassette-futurism.name: Cassette Futurism
cassette-futurism.thesis: The future is a machine with visible switches: every function has a physical control, a label and a status light, and the casing shows the wear of use.

punk-zine.name: Punk Zine
punk-zine.thesis: Anyone can publish: make the page with scissors, glue and a copier, and show the seams on purpose.

usenet-thread.name: Usenet Thread
usenet-thread.thesis: A discussion is a tree of plain-text replies, and each reply quotes the part that it answers.

memphis-design.name: Memphis Design
memphis-design.thesis: Good taste is a convention, and a loud, cheap, playful object can carry as much meaning as a serious one.

ansi-bbs-art.name: ANSI BBS Art
ansi-bbs-art.thesis: A picture is a grid of characters: every shape must fit an 8 by 16 pixel cell and one of 16 colours.

kaomoji-emoticon.name: Kaomoji and Emoticon
kaomoji-emoticon.thesis: A face needs no picture: a few characters of one text font, in one colour, carry a whole feeling.

cyberdelia.name: Cyberdelia
cyberdelia.thesis: The computer is a consciousness machine: use acid colour, fractal repetition and raw early software effects to show a mind that has gone into the network.

grunge-editorial.name: Grunge Editorial
grunge-editorial.thesis: Legibility is not the same as communication, and a page can carry the mood of its content by looking as rough as the content feels.

net-art-browser.name: Net Art Browser
net-art-browser.thesis: The browser is the material: show its defaults, its errors and its source as the work itself.

geocities-homepage.name: GeoCities Homepage
geocities-homepage.thesis: Every person owns a page, and the page shows what its owner loves, with no care for taste.

bulletin-board-forum.name: Bulletin Board Forum
bulletin-board-forum.thesis: A forum is a club with rooms; each member carries a visible rank, a picture and a signature from post to post.

portal-table-layout.name: Portal Table Layout
portal-table-layout.thesis: One page holds the whole web: pack every service, link and ad into a clear table of boxes.

y2k-aesthetic.name: Y2K Aesthetic
y2k-aesthetic.thesis: Technology is friendly and the future is shiny, so an interface should look like a new gadget that is already finished.

flash-intro-site.name: Flash Intro Site
flash-intro-site.thesis: A site is a performance: control every pixel and every second, and make the visitor wait for it.

japanese-dense-web.name: Japanese Dense Web
japanese-dense-web.thesis: Density is hospitality: show all the options at once, so the visitor never has to search.

apple-aqua.name: Apple Aqua
apple-aqua.thesis: The screen is a liquid, tactile surface: every control is a glossy drop that invites a click.

anonymous-imageboard.name: Anonymous Imageboard
anonymous-imageboard.thesis: Nobody has a name, so only the post counts; the newest reply keeps a thread alive.

myspace-profile.name: Myspace Profile
myspace-profile.thesis: A profile is a bedroom wall: the owner decorates it, and the decoration says who they are.

demotivational-poster.name: Demotivational poster
demotivational-poster.thesis: Turn the cheerful office poster into a dry joke: the same frame and layout, with a bleak caption.

frutiger-aero.name: Frutiger Aero
frutiger-aero.thesis: Technology belongs to nature and the human world, so a digital interface should look clean, glossy, alive and pleasant to touch.

web-2-0-gloss.name: Web 2.0 Gloss
web-2-0-gloss.thesis: A site is a friendly tool: make every control look glossy, round and easy to press.

reddit-thread.name: Reddit Thread
reddit-thread.thesis: The crowd ranks every post and every reply; the best answer floats to the top.

impact-image-macro.name: Impact image macro
impact-image-macro.thesis: Make the caption the picture: one setup line on top, one punch line below, in a font that stays legible at any size.

unboxing-video.name: Unboxing Video
unboxing-video.thesis: The viewer owns the first touch by proxy: show the opening of the box in real time and let the object, not the frame, carry the interest.

skeuomorphism.name: Skeuomorphism
skeuomorphism.thesis: A screen control is easier to learn when it looks and behaves like a physical object that the user already knows.

rage-comic.name: Rage comic
rage-comic.thesis: Tell a small daily frustration in a few crude panels, with stock faces that every reader knows.

reaction-gif.name: Reaction GIF
reaction-gif.thesis: A looped second of a real face says a feeling faster than a sentence, so the clip is the reply.

asmr-video.name: ASMR Video
asmr-video.thesis: Slow the image to match the sound: a calm frame, a soft light and a close mic make the viewer relax.

glitch-gif.name: Glitch GIF
glitch-gif.thesis: A fault in the signal is an image: show the error, do not hide it.

instagram-vintage-filter.name: Instagram Vintage Filter
instagram-vintage-filter.thesis: One tap turns a plain phone snapshot into a keepsake: the filter, the frame and the vignette supply the age that the photo does not have.

lets-play-facecam.name: Let's Play Facecam
lets-play-facecam.thesis: The game is the stage and the face is the audience: put the reaction next to the action, and the viewer follows the player, not the game.

metro-ui.name: Metro UI
metro-ui.thesis: Content is the interface: remove chrome, use type and motion for hierarchy, and let flat colour tiles carry the brand.

pixel-art-web.name: Pixel Art Web
pixel-art-web.thesis: Limits are the style: few pixels, few colours and a hard grid make a clear, playful picture.

unicode-emoji.name: Unicode Emoji
unicode-emoji.thesis: A picture becomes a character: the same small yellow face can enter any text on any device.

wojak-feels.name: Wojak and feels
wojak-feels.thesis: Reduce a mood to one drawn face and a short label, so that a reader sees the feeling at once.

chat-sticker-pack.name: Chat Sticker Pack
chat-sticker-pack.thesis: A character with a big face says what a sentence cannot: the chat gets a mascot with a voice.

cinemagraph.name: Cinemagraph
cinemagraph.thesis: The image is still, and one small motion makes the viewer look longer.

livestream-overlay.name: Livestream Overlay
livestream-overlay.thesis: A live show needs a control room on screen: the frame holds every live signal in fixed slots, so the viewer always knows where to look.

seapunk.name: Seapunk
seapunk.thesis: Put the early web underwater: its 3D shapes, clip art and gradients float on a sea of turquoise.

bohemian-web.name: Bohemian Web
bohemian-web.thesis: The page is a lived-in, free-spirited space: natural, layered and warm.

clickbait-thumbnail.name: Clickbait Thumbnail
clickbait-thumbnail.thesis: The still has one second to ask a question: show one clear shock, one object and 3 words, and make it readable at the size of a thumb.

flat-design.name: Flat Design
flat-design.thesis: A digital interface is honest when it shows itself as pixels and type, and does not imitate physical objects.

minimalism-web.name: Minimalism Web
minimalism-web.thesis: Remove until only the need is left: space and restraint carry the message.

tumblr-soft-grunge.name: Tumblr Soft Grunge
tumblr-soft-grunge.thesis: A feed of reblogged scraps that feels like a teenager's wall: faded, tender and a little broken.

vaporwave.name: Vaporwave
vaporwave.thesis: Nostalgia for a future that did not happen: use the dead gloss of 1990s corporate culture to question it.

cyberpunk-web.name: Cyberpunk Web
cyberpunk-web.thesis: The future is crowded, dirty and bright: neon on dark, data everywhere.

health-goth.name: Health Goth
health-goth.thesis: Treat the body and the interface as one clean, dark machine: goth mood, gym function, no decoration that has no use.

normcore.name: Normcore
normcore.thesis: Choose sameness over difference: a look that blends in is a calm answer to a feed that rewards standing out.

synthwave-web.name: Synthwave Web
synthwave-web.thesis: The 1980s as a dream: neon, chrome and a road to the horizon.

vsco-preset-look.name: VSCO Preset Look
vsco-preset-look.thesis: A preset, not a filter: the edit imitates a real film stock and must look as if no edit happened.

brutalist-web.name: Brutalist Web (2014)
brutalist-web.thesis: A page is a document, not a product: show the raw structure and the web serves the reader without decoration.

flat-lay-feed.name: Flat Lay Feed
flat-lay-feed.thesis: A life laid flat on a table: choose objects, set them in order and shoot straight down so that the story reads like a diagram.

luxury-typography-web.name: Luxury Typography Web
luxury-typography-web.thesis: Luxury is restraint and craft: fine type, wide space and few words.

material-design.name: Material Design
material-design.thesis: Digital surfaces behave like sheets of paper with thickness and shadow, so that depth and motion explain the hierarchy of the interface.

starter-pack.name: Starter pack
starter-pack.thesis: Describe a type of person as a kit of things you can buy, wear and say.

video-essay.name: Video Essay
video-essay.thesis: Treat the frame as a page of an essay: one claim, one piece of evidence, and a quiet layout that lets the argument lead.

blob-world.name: Blob World
blob-world.thesis: Make the screen a toy world: soft, over-lit 3D bodies with odd textures carry the brand, and the interface stays plain around them.

conceptual-sketch-ui.name: Conceptual Sketch UI
conceptual-sketch-ui.thesis: The page shows thinking: a rough line says the idea is open and honest.

deepdream-psychedelia.name: DeepDream Psychedelia
deepdream-psychedelia.thesis: A machine that looks for patterns finds them in everything: the picture shows what the network expects to see, and it shows it everywhere.

discord-server.name: Discord Server
discord-server.thesis: A community lives in a room that is always open, and the talk flows in real time instead of in threads.

tweet-screenshot-meme.name: Tweet screenshot meme
tweet-screenshot-meme.thesis: Use the plain look of a social post as a frame, so that the text reads as a real voice.

wabi-sabi-web.name: Wabi-Sabi Web
wabi-sabi-web.thesis: Imperfection is beauty: a worn, quiet surface shows time and honest craft.

anti-design.name: Anti-Design
anti-design.thesis: Polish is a lie: a page that breaks the rules on purpose shows that people made it.

cohesive-feed-grid.name: Cohesive Feed Grid
cohesive-feed-grid.thesis: The grid is the product: each photo serves the profile page, so tone, colour and spacing repeat until the feed reads as one brand.

dark-devtool-ui.name: Dark-Mode Developer Tool
dark-devtool-ui.thesis: A tool for experts is a dense, calm, dark instrument: show a lot, keep it quiet and make everything reachable from the keyboard.

lip-sync-dance-short.name: Lip-Sync Dance Short
lip-sync-dance-short.thesis: One person, one song hook and one move: the clip works when the body and the beat are the only content.

surreal-meme.name: Surreal meme
surreal-meme.thesis: Drop the joke structure: let a strange picture and a calm caption make a mood with no answer.

surrealism-web.name: Surrealism Web
surrealism-web.thesis: Put the impossible on a quiet page: strange images, clear controls.

vtuber-avatar.name: VTuber Avatar
vtuber-avatar.thesis: The host is a character: a tracked avatar gives a person a face that is safe, stable and designed, and the frame is dressed to match.

3d-avatar-emoji.name: 3D Avatar Emoji
3d-avatar-emoji.thesis: The emoji copies the face of the sender: a mask with a voice, not a fixed picture.

corporate-memphis.name: Corporate Memphis
corporate-memphis.thesis: Friendly, abstract people with unreal bodies make a corporate product feel human and inclusive without the risk of a specific face.

deep-fried-meme.name: Deep-fried meme
deep-fried-meme.thesis: Show the damage as the joke: a picture so copied and boosted that its own decay is the style.

deepfake-face-swap.name: Deepfake Face Swap
deepfake-face-swap.thesis: The face in the frame is a layer, and the layer shows its seam: the style marks where a real image ends and a made image starts.

label-meme.name: Label meme
label-meme.thesis: Let a famous picture act as a diagram: the labels give the roles, and the pose gives the joke.

terminal-tui-web.name: Terminal / TUI Web
terminal-tui-web.thesis: The terminal is the honest interface: a fixed character grid, text only and a keyboard make a tool fast and trustworthy.

aurora-gradient-ui.name: Aurora Gradient UI
aurora-gradient-ui.thesis: Colour is atmosphere: a blurred field of light makes a product feel alive without any picture of it.

cottagecore.name: Cottagecore
cottagecore.thesis: Pick the slow, handmade country day as a refuge from the feed that carries it.

duet-split-screen.name: Duet Split-Screen
duet-split-screen.thesis: The frame is a conversation: one original clip, one answer, both visible at the same time.

gan-portrait.name: GAN Portrait
gan-portrait.thesis: A face that nobody owns: the model averages thousands of faces into one believable head, and its faults are the signature.

scrapbook-ui.name: Scrapbook UI
scrapbook-ui.thesis: The page is a handmade album: warm, imperfect and made by a person.

dark-academia.name: Dark academia
dark-academia.thesis: Treat study as a dark, romantic rite: books, old stone and candlelight make the learned life feel fated.

dreamcore.name: Dreamcore
dreamcore.thesis: Show a memory as a dream does: soft, glowing and slightly wrong, with the details out of focus.

glitchcore.name: Glitchcore
glitchcore.thesis: Overload the signal: show the fault, the repeat and the flash until the error becomes the style.

grwm-short.name: Get Ready With Me
grwm-short.thesis: Share a real routine in real time: the talk matters more than the result.

hyperpop-visual.name: Hyperpop Visual
hyperpop-visual.thesis: Make pop too sweet and too bright: take cute and chrome so far that they look artificial and strange.

kidcore.name: Kidcore
kidcore.thesis: Treat the childhood bedroom of the 1990s as a design system: bright, crowded and joyful on purpose.

liminal-spaces.name: Liminal spaces
liminal-spaces.thesis: An ordinary place with no people and no purpose feels strange: the viewer meets the unease of a threshold.

neumorphism.name: Neumorphism
neumorphism.thesis: An interface can be tactile without imitating objects, if every control is moulded from the same material as the page behind it.

cybercore-web.name: Cybercore Web
cybercore-web.thesis: The page is a machine interface: sharp, labelled, cold and dense with data.

glassmorphism.name: Glassmorphism
glassmorphism.thesis: Layers are readable when each one is a pane of frosted glass: it shows what lies beneath it and still keeps its own plane.

goblincore.name: Goblincore
goblincore.thesis: Find beauty in mud, rot and clutter: the untidy forest floor is a better home than a clean showroom.

green-screen-short.name: Green-Screen Short
green-screen-short.thesis: Put the speaker in front of the evidence: the image is the set, the creator is the commentator.

neo-brutalism-ui.name: Neo-Brutalism UI
neo-brutalism-ui.thesis: An interface earns trust by showing its structure openly and being loud about it, because every border and shadow is a stated fact.

photo-dump.name: Photo Dump
photo-dump.thesis: The opposite of the curated grid: show the camera roll as it is, so that the poster looks relaxed and real.

pov-short.name: POV Short
pov-short.thesis: Make the viewer the second person in the scene: the caption names the situation, the lens is the viewer.

velocity-edit.name: Velocity Edit
velocity-edit.thesis: Let time bend to the music: slow on the strong beat, fast on the rest.

weirdcore.name: Weirdcore
weirdcore.thesis: Make a familiar thing wrong in one small way, and let the poor image quality carry the unease.

word-caption-clip.name: Word Caption Clip
word-caption-clip.thesis: Make every word visible at the moment it is spoken: the caption is the main picture, and the viewer reads and hears the same beat.

claymorphism.name: Claymorphism
claymorphism.thesis: The interface is a toy: soft, inflated forms with colour make the screen friendly and touchable.

editorial-serif-revival.name: Editorial Serif Revival
editorial-serif-revival.thesis: Voice beats neutrality: a serif with character makes a brand sound like a person, as in a magazine.

ethereal-web.name: Ethereal Web
ethereal-web.thesis: Lightness is luxury: haze, glow and space make a quiet, weightless world.

ai-avatar-portrait.name: AI Avatar Portrait
ai-avatar-portrait.thesis: One face, many costumes: the pack turns a selfie into a character sheet, and the glow is the reward.

ai-chat-ui.name: AI Chat Interface
ai-chat-ui.thesis: The interface is a conversation: one box to speak into, and everything else appears in the reply.

barbiecore.name: Barbiecore
barbiecore.thesis: Make the whole world one pink, and play with it: toy gloss and total colour turn a doll into a dress code.

bento-grid-ui.name: Bento Grid UI
bento-grid-ui.thesis: A page is easiest to scan when every idea sits in its own compartment and the compartments tile one tight, regular grid.

clean-girl.name: Clean girl
clean-girl.thesis: Show effortless order: a polished, neutral surface suggests a calm life, and the routine is the product.

diffusion-gloss.name: Diffusion Gloss
diffusion-gloss.thesis: Everything is lit, sharp and finished: the model gives each surface the same expensive sheen, and the sheen is the style.

dual-camera-snapshot.name: Dual Camera Snapshot
dual-camera-snapshot.thesis: Proof of a real moment: two cameras fire at once, there is no edit, and the late mark shows that the poster did not stage it.

mini-diffusion-meme.name: Mini-Diffusion Meme
mini-diffusion-meme.thesis: The joke is the gap between a plain prompt and a soft, wrong picture; the smudge is the format.

photo-carousel-slideshow.name: Photo Carousel Slideshow
photo-carousel-slideshow.thesis: Slow the feed down: one idea on each still slide, one swipe at a time.

spatial-visionos.name: Spatial UI (visionOS)
spatial-visionos.thesis: An interface in space should be a physical presence in the room, so it uses glass that takes light from the real scene and respects the person's field of view.

ai-slop.name: AI Slop
ai-slop.thesis: The image exists to fill a feed: it has a high finish, no author and no point, and its small errors show the lack of care.

liquid-glass-ui.name: Liquid Glass
liquid-glass-ui.thesis: Controls are a transparent lens above the content: the interface floats, refracts the page and stays out of the way.

gothic-architecture.name: Gothic
gothic-architecture.thesis: A building is a stone skeleton that lifts the eye to heaven: the thrust of each vault is caught by a buttress, so that walls can dissolve into light.

renaissance-architecture.name: Renaissance
renaissance-architecture.thesis: Beauty is number: a building is right when each part is a simple ratio of the whole, as in the human body and in music.

baroque-architecture.name: Baroque
baroque-architecture.thesis: Architecture should move the viewer: curve, depth, light and ornament make one dramatic effect, in the service of church and crown.

neoclassical-architecture.name: Neoclassicism
neoclassical-architecture.thesis: Architecture should be reasoned: build from the first principles of the Greek temple, and let the plain wall and a true order carry the dignity of the state.

arts-and-crafts-architecture.name: Arts and Crafts
arts-and-crafts-architecture.thesis: A building should be made by skilled hands from local material, planned for the life inside it, and its construction should be seen and enjoyed.

beaux-arts-architecture.name: Beaux-Arts
beaux-arts-architecture.thesis: A great building is planned first: the parti is a clear sequence of axes, rooms and routes, and classical ornament and sculpture crown the plan.

art-nouveau-architecture.name: Art Nouveau
art-nouveau-architecture.thesis: A building should grow like a plant: structure, ornament and furniture follow one organic line, and iron and glass are shown as the new materials of the age.

prairie-school-architecture.name: Prairie School
prairie-school-architecture.thesis: A house should belong to its land: low horizontal lines, a free plan around the hearth and honest materials make an American architecture of the prairie.

organic-architecture.name: Organic Architecture
organic-architecture.thesis: A building should grow from its site and its use as a living form: the whole and the parts belong together, and the plan flows with the land.

expressionist-architecture.name: Expressionist Architecture
expressionist-architecture.thesis: A building should carry an inner feeling in its form: the architect sculpts one dynamic mass, and the plan and the facade follow that gesture.

bauhaus-architecture.name: Bauhaus Architecture
bauhaus-architecture.thesis: Form follows use: each function gets its own volume, and the plan is the generator of the building, not the facade.

art-deco-architecture.name: Art Deco
art-deco-architecture.thesis: Modern technology deserves luxury: the machine age should look glamorous, symmetric and expensive.

international-style-architecture.name: International Style
international-style-architecture.thesis: A building is a volume enclosed by a thin skin, and industrial methods make one rational form valid in every place.

nordic-modernism-architecture.name: Nordic Modernism
nordic-modernism-architecture.thesis: Modern architecture should serve the whole person: use natural materials, scarce daylight and a human scale to make function warm.

mid-century-modern-architecture.name: Mid-century Modern
mid-century-modern-architecture.thesis: Modern architecture can be warm: the free plan and the glass wall serve everyday life, and the house belongs to its garden.

brutalist-architecture.name: Brutalism
brutalist-architecture.thesis: A building is honest when its material, its structure and its use are legible from the street.

adaptive-reuse-architecture.name: Adaptive Reuse
adaptive-reuse-architecture.thesis: An existing building has value in its fabric and its memory, so keep it, change its use and let the new work be clearly new beside the old.

postmodern-architecture.name: Postmodernism
postmodern-architecture.thesis: Architecture is communication: a building should carry meaning, memory and irony, and a decorated shed is better than a blank box.

high-tech-architecture.name: High-tech
high-tech-architecture.thesis: A building is a machine of parts: structure, services and circulation are tools to see and to change, and open floors let the use change.

critical-regionalism-architecture.name: Critical Regionalism
critical-regionalism-architecture.thesis: A building should use modern means to answer a specific place: its climate, its materials and its craft give the form, and universal style and nostalgia are both refused.

deconstructivist-architecture.name: Deconstructivism
deconstructivist-architecture.thesis: The pure form is already flawed: distort the grid, collide the volumes and let the building show that order is unstable.

mass-timber-architecture.name: Mass Timber
mass-timber-architecture.thesis: A building can be made of engineered timber panels and beams, and so store carbon, build fast off site and show the warm grain of its own structure.

parametricism-architecture.name: Parametricism
parametricism-architecture.thesis: A design is a system of linked parameters, so every part can differ and follow the others in a smooth gradient: one fluid field replaces the rigid, repeated element.

georgian-interior.name: Georgian
georgian-interior.thesis: A room is good when its proportions obey the classical rules and each wall answers the wall opposite it.

shaker-interior.name: Shaker
shaker-interior.thesis: A room is beautiful when each object in it is useful, well made and in its place.

victorian-interior.name: Victorian
victorian-interior.thesis: A home shows the taste, the travels and the respectability of its family; more objects and more pattern mean more comfort.

arts-and-crafts-interior.name: Arts and Crafts
arts-and-crafts-interior.thesis: A room is honest when every piece is made by hand from local materials and shows how it is made.

art-nouveau-interior.name: Art Nouveau
art-nouveau-interior.thesis: Nature gives the only true line; one designer must draw every part of a room so that it grows as one plant.

bauhaus-interior.name: Bauhaus interior
bauhaus-interior.thesis: A room is a machine for daily life, and industry can make each of its parts well and for everyone.

art-deco-interior.name: Art Deco
art-deco-interior.thesis: Luxury and the machine meet in one bold geometric order of rare materials and high contrast.

hollywood-regency-interior.name: Hollywood Regency
hollywood-regency-interior.thesis: A room is a stage set: bold colour, gloss and symmetry make the people in it look their best.

mid-century-modern-interior.name: Mid-century modern interior
mid-century-modern-interior.thesis: The modern home joins the room to the landscape, and good design made in series can be warm as well as rational.

scandinavian-interior.name: Scandinavian interior
scandinavian-interior.thesis: A home for a long dark winter must be bright, warm in material and made of few good things that last.

industrial-loft-interior.name: Industrial loft
industrial-loft-interior.thesis: The building tells of its past as a factory; leave the structure and the services in view and live among them.

memphis-interior.name: Memphis interior
memphis-interior.thesis: Function is not the only meaning of an object; colour, pattern and irony are functions too.

coastal-interior.name: Coastal interior
coastal-interior.thesis: A house by the sea takes its colours from sand, water and weathered wood, and its comfort from loose, washable fabric.

minimalist-interior.name: Minimalist
minimalist-interior.thesis: Remove every thing that is not necessary, so that space, light and material can be seen.

japandi-interior.name: Japandi
japandi-interior.thesis: Calm comes from emptiness and from a few natural things made by hand and placed with care.

grandmillennial-interior.name: Grandmillennial
grandmillennial-interior.thesis: Comfort and memory beat the cool, empty room: inherited, pretty and patterned things make a home.

neo-deco-interior.name: Neo-deco
neo-deco-interior.thesis: Deco glamour without the hard edges: curves, ribs and warm metal make luxury feel soft and personal.

dopamine-decor.name: Dopamine decor
dopamine-decor.thesis: Colour and play in the home lift the mood, and a room must show the joy of the person who lives in it.

quiet-luxury-interior.name: Quiet luxury
quiet-luxury-interior.thesis: Real luxury is the quality of the material and the work, and it does not need to show a name.

pictorialism.name: Pictorialism
pictorialism.thesis: A photograph is art when the maker's hand shows in the image, so the print must look made and not recorded.

straight-photography.name: Straight photography
straight-photography.thesis: Photography is an art of its own when it shows the world with the full detail and tonal range that only a camera can record.

group-f64.name: Group f/64
group-f64.thesis: Pure photography needs no borrowed look from painting; the large camera, the small stop and the full tonal scale are enough.

new-objectivity.name: New Objectivity photography
new-objectivity.thesis: The lens is exact and unsentimental, so the honest picture shows the structure of a thing at close range and in full detail.

street-photography.name: Street photography
street-photography.thesis: Public life holds pictures that nobody can stage, and the photographer's job is to be in the right place and to see them in time.

documentary-photography.name: Documentary photography
documentary-photography.thesis: A photograph can be evidence and an appeal at once, if the maker stays honest about what happened and with whom.

new-colour.name: New Colour
new-colour.thesis: Colour is the subject and not a decoration, and the everyday world is rich enough to need no drama.

new-topographics.name: New Topographics
new-topographics.thesis: The ordinary, man-made landscape deserves the formal care that the sublime wilderness once received, and the photographer's voice should stay out of it.

duesseldorf-school.name: Düsseldorf School
duesseldorf-school.thesis: Seen without drama and in great detail, an ordinary place becomes a map of the way we live.

y2k-digicam.name: Y2K digicam
y2k-digicam.thesis: The flaws of a cheap early sensor are the style: they mark a moment in time and read as honest.

cinematic-teal-orange.name: Cinematic teal and orange
cinematic-teal-orange.thesis: Two opposed hues, the warm skin and the cool environment, give a frame instant depth and a sense of cinema.

party-flash.name: Party flash
party-flash.thesis: The harsh direct flash is the honest light of a real night, and an image that looks unplanned and unflattering reads as truthful and as cool.

film-grain-revival.name: Film grain revival
film-grain-revival.thesis: Grain and imperfection give a picture a body, so the viewer believes it was lived and not rendered.

ai-hyperreal.name: AI hyperreal image
ai-hyperreal.thesis: A generated image can pass for a photograph at a glance, and its tells are the numbers that no real camera and no real scene would give together.

architectural-photography.name: Architectural photography
architectural-photography.thesis: A building is judged in a picture, so the picture must keep its lines true and choose the light that shows its form.

fashion-editorial.name: Fashion editorial photography
fashion-editorial.thesis: Fashion sells a feeling before it sells a thing, so the photograph builds the whole world around the clothes.

film-noir-still.name: Film noir still photography
film-noir-still.thesis: Darkness holds the story, so the picture shows only as much light as the mood needs.

food-photography.name: Food photography
food-photography.thesis: Food is a sensation, so the picture shows texture, steam and light before it shows the plate.

scandinavian-interior-photography.name: Scandinavian interior photography
scandinavian-interior-photography.thesis: A room looks livable when the light is honest and the objects are few, so the picture shows the light first.

german-expressionist-cinema.name: German Expressionist cinema
german-expressionist-cinema.thesis: The set, the light and the body show inner fear, so the picture is built as a state of mind and not recorded as a place.

soviet-montage.name: Soviet montage
soviet-montage.thesis: Meaning comes from the collision of shots, not from the content of a single shot, so the edit is the author of the film.

classical-hollywood.name: Classical Hollywood
classical-hollywood.thesis: A film serves its story, so every device (light, angle, cut and score) is invisible and keeps the viewer's eye on the character and the action.

film-noir.name: Film noir
film-noir.thesis: One hard lamp, a low camera and a narrow strip of light turn a city into a trap, so the viewer feels the fate of the hero before the hero does.

italian-neorealism.name: Italian Neorealism
italian-neorealism.thesis: A film earns its truth by going out of the studio and showing ordinary lives in the real place, at the real pace, with no star and no neat plot.

one-take-oner.name: The oner
one-take-oner.thesis: One unbroken shot holds the viewer in real time and space, so the viewer cannot look away and feels each mistake and each turn as the actors do.

french-new-wave.name: French New Wave
french-new-wave.thesis: A film is a personal essay shot on location with light gear, so the director's eye and the street replace the studio and the script department.

documentary-verite.name: Direct cinema and vérité
documentary-verite.thesis: Light gear and sync sound let the camera watch people in real time, so the film is made of what happens and not of what is staged.

giallo.name: Giallo
giallo.thesis: Saturated gel light, a killer's-eye camera and a stylised set make the murder a piece of design, so fear comes from the look more than from the plot.

spaghetti-western.name: Spaghetti western
spaghetti-western.thesis: An extreme close-up and an extreme wide shot, with a long wait between them, make a duel into a ritual and the land into a stage.

new-hollywood.name: New Hollywood
new-hollywood.thesis: The studio picture is used for a director's personal, sceptical view, so the heroes are flawed, the places are real and the endings stay open.

music-video.name: Music video
music-video.thesis: The song is the script, so images are cut to its beat and structure and a loud, memorable look sells the artist.

neon-noir.name: Neon noir
neon-noir.thesis: Coloured signs and a synth score turn the noir trap into a glowing night city, so the viewer reads loneliness in a clean, still, stylised frame.

hong-kong-action.name: Hong Kong action
hong-kong-action.thesis: An action scene is a piece of choreography shot and cut for its rhythm, so the stunt is shown whole and the cut gives it speed and weight.

slow-cinema.name: Slow cinema
slow-cinema.thesis: Time is the material of film, so a shot is held until the viewer sees the place and the person and feels the hours pass.

dogme-95.name: Dogme 95
dogme-95.thesis: A fixed set of prohibitions removes illusion, polish and the director's taste, so that the truth of the scene remains.

planimetric-symmetry.name: Planimetric symmetry
planimetric-symmetry.thesis: A film is a constructed object, so the frame is composed as a flat, symmetrical tableau and the camera moves only at right angles to it.

found-footage.name: Found footage
found-footage.thesis: If a character holds the camera, the frame shows only what that person can see, so the viewer cannot look away from the dark edge of the picture.

mumblecore.name: Mumblecore
mumblecore.thesis: A cheap digital camera and a few friends are enough to film the small, awkward moments of a relationship, so the film trusts the talk and not the polish.

creator-vlog.name: Creator vlog
creator-vlog.thesis: A direct address from one person, tightened by the jump cut, builds more trust than a produced film, so the creator's pace is the style.

phone-cinema.name: Phone cinema
phone-cinema.thesis: A phone is light, cheap and always present, so a crew of 3 can shoot a feature in real streets and fix the look with an app and a grade.

vertical-short-form.name: Vertical short-form
vertical-short-form.thesis: A viewer swipes in 1 to 2 s, so every second must earn the next: the hook, the cut and the caption are the whole design.

cinematic-fpv.name: Cinematic FPV
cinematic-fpv.thesis: A camera that can go anywhere should not cut: one unbroken flight turns space itself into the story.

camcorder-revival.name: Camcorder revival
camcorder-revival.thesis: A flawed, low-resolution tape image looks like a real memory, so the defect is the proof of the moment.

renaissance-painting.name: Renaissance painting
renaissance-painting.thesis: A picture is a window onto a measured space, and the ideal human body is the measure of that space.

mannerism-painting.name: Mannerism
mannerism-painting.thesis: A picture is most beautiful when it shows skill and invention, so the painter stretches, twists and crowds the ideal body past nature.

baroque-painting.name: Baroque painting
baroque-painting.thesis: A picture is a staged moment in which light decides what matters and the viewer feels the event.

ukiyo-e.name: Ukiyo-e
ukiyo-e.thesis: A picture is a printed sheet in which the contour, the flat colour and the cropped viewpoint carry everything, and the moment is as fleeting as the city.

rococo-painting.name: Rococo
rococo-painting.thesis: A picture should give pleasure: it is a refined, light and intimate object that charms the eye, and it does not preach or overwhelm.

romanticism-painting.name: Romanticism
romanticism-painting.thesis: A picture should move the viewer by emotion and by awe, and so the painter puts feeling, nature and imagination above the cool rules of the academy.

realism-painting.name: Realism
realism-painting.thesis: A picture should record the real world of its own time, and ordinary work and ordinary people are as worthy a subject as a king or a god.

impressionism.name: Impressionism
impressionism.thesis: A picture records the impression of light on a surface at one moment, not the object as it is known to be.

nordic-national-romanticism-painting.name: Nordic national romanticism
nordic-national-romanticism-painting.thesis: A picture can give a young nation a face by painting its own land, light, legends and home with the best methods of Europe.

pointillism.name: Pointillism
pointillism.thesis: Colour is a science: pure dots set side by side mix in the eye with more light than a mix on the palette, and a picture can be built by rule.

post-impressionism.name: Post-Impressionism
post-impressionism.thesis: A picture should do more than record a glance: colour, line and stroke build lasting form and carry the feeling of the painter.

symbolism-painting.name: Symbolism
symbolism-painting.thesis: A picture should suggest an inner idea by symbol and mood, and should turn from the plain surface of the visible world toward dream and the spirit.

expressionism-painting.name: Expressionism
expressionism-painting.thesis: A picture shows what the painter feels, not what the eye sees, so that form and colour are distorted until they carry the emotion.

fauvism.name: Fauvism
fauvism.thesis: Colour is free from the object: the painter chooses a hue for its force and its relations, and so builds the picture and the feeling by colour alone.

cubism-painting.name: Cubism
cubism-painting.thesis: A picture is an object in its own right, and it shows what a thing is by combining several viewpoints on one flat surface.

futurism-painting.name: Futurism
futurism-painting.thesis: Modern life is speed and energy, so a picture should show movement itself: the form is cut and repeated in time and fused with its setting.

suprematism.name: Suprematism
suprematism.thesis: Art should free itself from the object: pure shapes in a limitless white field give the feeling of form and of space and nothing else.

de-stijl-painting.name: De Stijl painting
de-stijl-painting.thesis: A picture shows universal order when it uses only the horizontal and the vertical, the three primaries and the three non-colours, balanced without symmetry.

surrealism-painting.name: Surrealism
surrealism-painting.thesis: A picture can show the mind below reason, and so it joins plain, exact things in a way that no waking logic allows.

abstract-expressionism.name: Abstract Expressionism
abstract-expressionism.thesis: A painting is the record of an act, and its scale, its marks and its colour put the viewer inside the feeling and not in front of an image.

colour-field-painting.name: Colour Field Painting
colour-field-painting.thesis: Colour alone can carry feeling and space: a large, simple field of hue, with no gesture and no drawing, surrounds the viewer and acts at once.

pop-art-painting.name: Pop Art
pop-art-painting.thesis: Everyday mass images are the subject of the age, and a painting can take their look, their flat colour and their repeat, without comment and without the artist's hand.

minimalism-painting.name: Minimalism
minimalism-painting.thesis: A picture is a plain object: what you see is what is there, so that form is reduced to the fewest parts and no illusion, gesture or story remains.

photorealism.name: Photorealism
photorealism.thesis: A painting can match the camera: the artist works from a photograph, keeps its sharp focus and its flat modern light, and shows the city as the lens sees it.

airbrush-surrealism.name: Airbrush Surrealism
airbrush-surrealism.thesis: A dream can be rendered as a polished object: the airbrush gives an impossible scene the smooth, lit surface of a photograph.

victorian-trademark.name: Victorian trademark
victorian-trademark.thesis: A mark earns trust when it shows a rich, finished picture and the full name of the maker, so the buyer sees the cost and the care behind the goods.

art-nouveau-monogram.name: Art Nouveau monogram
art-nouveau-monogram.thesis: The letters and the ornament are one drawing: a mark grows like a plant from one line, and the hand of the artist shows in each curve.

emblem-badge.name: Emblem and badge
emblem-badge.thesis: A mark that is a closed seal says membership and authority: the frame tells the viewer that everything inside belongs together.

swiss-modernist-mark.name: Swiss modernist corporate mark
swiss-modernist-mark.thesis: A mark is a tool of a system: it must be objective, reproducible in any medium, and the same at 5 mm and at 5 m.

geometric-symbol.name: Geometric abstract symbol
geometric-symbol.thesis: A pure form carries meaning by its structure alone: a square, a bar or a loop can say stability, growth or a cycle in every language.

minimal-wordmark.name: Wordmark-led minimal
minimal-wordmark.thesis: The name is the mark: one carefully spaced word, with one detail of its own, is clearer and more durable than any symbol.

glossy-3d-logo.name: Gradient 3D and glass
glossy-3d-logo.thesis: On a screen a mark can be a lit object: gloss, depth and reflection make it feel new, touchable and alive.

flat-logo.name: Flat 2010s mark
flat-logo.thesis: On a screen honesty is flat colour: a mark is a set of clean shapes that read at icon size and scale with no loss.

pixel-icon.name: Pixel icon
pixel-icon.thesis: An icon is a set of square pixels on a fixed grid, and the grid is part of the look, not a limit to hide.

isometric-icon.name: Isometric icon
isometric-icon.thesis: An icon can show an object as a solid in space and keep it exact, because parallel projection keeps every edge at a true angle.

skeuomorphic-icon.name: Skeuomorphic icon
skeuomorphic-icon.thesis: An icon is a small picture of a real object, and the material tells the user what the function is.

flat-icon.name: Flat icon
flat-icon.thesis: An icon is a sign, not a picture, and flat shapes in clear colour carry the meaning faster than material and light.

solid-glyph-icon.name: Solid glyph icon
solid-glyph-icon.thesis: An icon is a single solid mark, and a silhouette with cut-out details reads best at small sizes and on any ground.

outline-icon.name: Outline icon
outline-icon.thesis: An icon set is a typeface of objects: one stroke, one grid and one corner radius make hundreds of glyphs read as one family.

material-symbols-icon.name: Material Symbols
material-symbols-icon.thesis: An icon system is a set of tokens: one grid and four variable axes let one glyph serve every size, weight and state.

duotone-icon.name: Duotone icon
duotone-icon.thesis: One colour in two strengths gives an icon a figure and a ground, so the meaning reads first and the detail second.

clay-3d-icon.name: 3D clay icon
clay-3d-icon.thesis: After a decade of flat glyphs, an icon can have volume again if the forms stay simple, round and soft like a toy.

blackletter.name: Blackletter
blackletter.thesis: A letter written with a broad nib held at a steep angle breaks each curve into straight strokes and makes a dark, even texture on the page.

garalde-old-style.name: Garalde old-style serif
garalde-old-style.thesis: A text letter keeps the rhythm of the hand that wrote it, so the eye reads a page without effort.

formal-script.name: Formal script
formal-script.thesis: A letter is one movement of a flexible pointed pen: pressure on the downstroke, a hairline on the upstroke, and every letter joined to the next.

transitional-serif.name: Transitional serif
transitional-serif.thesis: A letter can be drawn by reason and still serve the reader: the pen gives way to the engraver's line, but not yet to the extreme.

didone-serif.name: Didone
didone-serif.thesis: A letter is a geometric figure of thick and thin, cut as fine as the metal and the paper allow.

fat-face-display.name: Fat face display
fat-face-display.thesis: A letter for a poster is as black as the stem can be while the hairlines keep it readable.

slab-serif.name: Slab serif
slab-serif.thesis: A letter for a loud and busy world must be heavy, square and hard to break.

grotesque-sans.name: Grotesque sans
grotesque-sans.thesis: A letter without serifs is plain, and the plain letter is the strongest one at a distance.

monospace.name: Monospace
monospace.thesis: When every character has the same width, columns align without a grid and each character is a unit the reader can count.

humanist-sans.name: Humanist sans
humanist-sans.thesis: A sans serif reads best when it keeps the proportions and the open forms of the written roman.

geometric-sans.name: Geometric sans
geometric-sans.thesis: A letter is a construction of pure forms, free of the hand and of history.

neo-grotesque-sans.name: Neo-grotesque sans
neo-grotesque-sans.thesis: A typeface is a neutral vessel: it carries the message and adds nothing of its own.

vector-display-arcade.name: Vector display arcade
vector-display-arcade.thesis: A world can be drawn with light alone: a few sharp glowing lines on black are enough for the eye to build space.

eight-bit-tile.name: 8-bit tile graphics
eight-bit-tile.thesis: A small grid and a small palette force each object into its clearest silhouette, so a house in 16 pixels reads at once.

isometric-pixel-world.name: Isometric pixel world
isometric-pixel-world.thesis: A fixed 2:1 diagonal gives depth with no perspective, so a room can be read whole like an architect's axonometric drawing.

sixteen-bit-sprite.name: 16-bit sprite and parallax
sixteen-bit-sprite.thesis: A richer palette and stacked layers let pixel art paint light, air and distance without a 3D engine.

four-shade-handheld.name: Four-shade handheld
four-shade-handheld.thesis: Four values of one colour are enough for a world, if the pattern and the outline carry the form.

pre-rendered-backgrounds.name: Pre-rendered backgrounds
pre-rendered-backgrounds.thesis: If the camera does not move, each view can be a finished render, composed like a film frame.

fifth-gen-low-poly.name: Fifth-generation low poly
fifth-gen-low-poly.thesis: A world of few polygons can still be entered: a box with a picture on each face becomes a room the camera walks into.

cel-shaded-3d.name: Cel-shaded 3D
cel-shaded-3d.thesis: Real-time 3D does not need to imitate a photograph; it can imitate a drawing and keep its clarity at any angle.

hand-painted-texture.name: Hand-painted texture
hand-painted-texture.thesis: A painter's hand can carry the light of a world, so a small engine budget still gives a warm, rich place.

seventh-gen-desaturated.name: Seventh-generation desaturated bloom
seventh-gen-desaturated.thesis: Realism is grit: a serious world is grey, worn and wet, and light blooms out of the dark.

voxel-block-world.name: Voxel block world
voxel-block-world.thesis: If the world is a grid of equal blocks, anyone can build in it, and the grid itself becomes the style.

pbr-photoreal.name: PBR photoreal
pbr-photoreal.thesis: If every material obeys the same physics of light, the world looks real from any angle and at any hour.

impossible-isometric-mobile.name: Flat geometric isometric
impossible-isometric-mobile.thesis: Architecture reduced to pure faces and an orthographic view becomes a calm puzzle that a hand can turn.

hd-2d-diorama.name: HD-2D diorama
hd-2d-diorama.thesis: Old pixel sprites inside modern light and depth of field read as a lovingly built miniature.

low-poly-ps1-revival.name: Low-poly PS1 revival
low-poly-ps1-revival.thesis: An old limit, chosen on purpose, makes a modern world feel like a half-remembered dream.

woodcut-relief-print.name: Woodcut relief print
woodcut-relief-print.thesis: A black line that stands on a block of wood can carry form, light and tone if the cutter swells, tapers and crosses it.

engraving-print.name: Copper engraving
engraving-print.thesis: A burin line that swells and tapers in polished copper gives the finest and most even tone that a hand can make.

etching-print.name: Etching
etching-print.thesis: A needle that moves through wax as easily as a pen gives the artist a free line, and the acid gives it depth.

mezzotint-print.name: Mezzotint
mezzotint-print.thesis: If the plate starts black, the artist works from dark to light and gets a tone as soft as paint, with no line.

wood-type-poster.name: Wood-type poster
wood-type-poster.thesis: A poster is a stack of words, and each line takes the largest and boldest type that fits the width.

chromolithograph-poster.name: Chromolithograph poster
chromolithograph-poster.thesis: A few bright inks, drawn by the artist on stone, can make a sheet on a wall as bright and as alive as a painting.

private-press-book.name: Private-press book
private-press-book.thesis: A book is one object: the type, the page, the paper, the ink and the ornament are made together and by hand.

ben-day-comic-print.name: Ben-Day comic print
ben-day-comic-print.thesis: Four inks, a black line and a few fixed tints of dots can colour a whole world for a cent.

pochoir-plate.name: Pochoir plate
pochoir-plate.thesis: A stencil and a brush give a flat, opaque and luminous colour that no press can match.

pop-screen-print.name: Pop screen print
pop-screen-print.thesis: A mechanical image, repeated and coloured by hand in loud inks, makes the familiar new.

psychedelic-concert-poster.name: Psychedelic concert poster
psychedelic-concert-poster.thesis: A poster that makes the viewer stop and decode it brings them into the dance before they read the date.

xerox-zine.name: Xerox zine
xerox-zine.thesis: If a copier is the press, anyone can publish, and the rough marks of the copy are proof of independence.

risograph-print.name: Risograph print
risograph-print.thesis: Bright spot inks that mix where they overlap, with a soft grain and a small shift, give a cheap print the warmth of a hand process.

victorian-web.name: Victorian Web
victorian-web.thesis: Ornament is value: every surface carries pattern, rule and flourish.

art-nouveau-web.name: Art Nouveau (web)
art-nouveau-web.thesis: Ornament is not decoration added to a thing: the line of the plant grows into the structure of the page.

de-stijl-web.name: De Stijl (web)
de-stijl-web.thesis: Reduce form to the straight line and the primary colour, and a universal, harmonious order appears.

bauhaus.name: Bauhaus
bauhaus.thesis: Form follows function, and a small kit of circle, square and triangle in three primary colours is enough to make any object for mass production.

constructivism-web.name: Constructivism (web)
constructivism-web.thesis: The page is a machine for persuasion: every element is a lever, and the diagonal gives it energy.

art-deco-web.name: Art Deco (web)
art-deco-web.thesis: Luxury is order: the machine age gives ornament a strict, symmetric geometry that looks rich and modern at once.

mid-century-modern.name: Mid-Century Modern
mid-century-modern.thesis: Modernist form can be warm and humane when abstract shapes, natural materials and a small earth palette serve everyday life.

swiss-international.name: Swiss International Style
swiss-international.thesis: Design is a neutral carrier of information, and a mathematical grid makes that neutrality visible.

japanese-graphic-modernism.name: Japanese Graphic Modernism
japanese-graphic-modernism.thesis: A single symbolic form on a quiet grid carries the whole message, and Japanese and Latin letters share the page as equal graphic material.

rams-functionalism-ui.name: Rams Functionalism (UI)
rams-functionalism-ui.thesis: Good design is as little design as possible: the product should be useful, understandable and honest, and then step back.

pop-art-web.name: Pop Art (web)
pop-art-web.thesis: Mass culture is the subject: the comic, the ad and the label become art when you make them big, flat and loud.

space-age.name: Space Age Design
space-age.thesis: The future is a place that people will visit, and a clean, rounded, machine-made form shows that the trip is safe and near.

psychedelic.name: Psychedelic
psychedelic.thesis: Design should alter perception, and a page that vibrates, flows and resists easy reading puts the viewer in an expanded state of mind.

georgian-neoclassical-manufacture.name: Georgian neoclassical manufacture
georgian-neoclassical-manufacture.thesis: A factory can make an object that looks like a work of antiquity: the form comes from the classical model, and the mould, the lathe and the die repeat it with a fine finish.

shaker-object.name: Shaker object
shaker-object.thesis: An object that serves its use well is beautiful; the maker adds no ornament, shows each joint and makes each piece with honest care.

victorian-manufacture.name: Victorian manufacture
victorian-manufacture.thesis: The machine makes ornament cheap, so each object can carry rich pattern, deep colour and heavy form as a sign of comfort and rank.

arts-and-crafts-object.name: Arts and Crafts object
arts-and-crafts-object.thesis: A good object shows the hand and the material that made it: the joint, the hammer mark and the grain are the ornament, and the maker is a free craftsman.

art-nouveau-object.name: Art Nouveau object
art-nouveau-object.thesis: An object grows like a plant: its structure and its ornament are one curved line, made by a craftsman from the best material.

industrial-utility-product.name: Industrial utility product
industrial-utility-product.thesis: A tool-like object earns its form from the job it does and the strain it takes; any surface that does no work is left off.

bauhaus-product.name: Bauhaus product
bauhaus-product.thesis: An everyday object is a model for the factory: its form comes from plain geometry, its material and its use, and ornament has no place on it.

art-deco-product.name: Art Deco product
art-deco-product.thesis: Luxury can be geometric: a rare material, a precise machine line and a bold pattern make an object that looks rich and modern.

scandinavian-modern-product.name: Scandinavian modern product
scandinavian-modern-product.thesis: A good object is a plain tool for a person: it is made of local wood and wool, shaped to the hand and the body, and built to last for decades.

streamline-moderne-product.name: Streamline Moderne product
streamline-moderne-product.thesis: A mass-made object should look as if it moves through air: a smooth shell, round corners and long lines show progress and sell.

mid-century-modern-product.name: Mid-century modern product
mid-century-modern-product.thesis: New materials from the war economy make a new kind of object: light, curved, bright and cheap enough for the new suburban home.

japanese-modern-craft-product.name: Japanese modern craft product
japanese-modern-craft-product.thesis: A useful object made with skill from a local material is beautiful without ornament; the maker's hand and the material leave the only decoration.

ulm-braun-functionalism.name: Ulm and Braun functionalism
ulm-braun-functionalism.thesis: A product is a system: it is as little design as possible, it explains its use, and it fits with its neighbours on a common grid.

space-age-pop-product.name: Space Age pop product
space-age-pop-product.thesis: The new plastics free the form: one mould makes a whole object in one piece, and its colour and curve show a hopeful, fast, technical future.

memphis-product.name: Memphis product
memphis-product.thesis: An object is a toy for the mind: it joins cheap, bright materials with symbols and jokes, and it refuses the rule that good taste is quiet.

contemporary-craft-product.name: Contemporary craft product
contemporary-craft-product.thesis: A good object is made by a person from one real material, and it gains value with use: its marks, its tone and its slow wear are the ornament.

super-normal-product.name: Super Normal product
super-normal-product.thesis: A good object is one that nobody notices: it does its job, it fits the hand and the room, and it needs no explanation or signature.

whalebone-stays.name: Whalebone Stays
whalebone-stays.thesis: A lady stands straight because her stays hold her straight, and the gown above shows the cone that they build.

georgian-jewellery.name: Georgian Jewellery
georgian-jewellery.thesis: In candlelight a jewel must return the flame. A sheet of foil under the stone and a closed setting make a small gem glow like a large one.

rococo-court-dress.name: Rococo court dress
rococo-court-dress.thesis: A court gown shows rank by the width of the skirt, the weight of the silk and the hours of hand work in the trim.

breguet-classical-watch.name: Breguet classical watch
breguet-classical-watch.thesis: A fine watch shows its worth by exact work and a quiet face, so each part is plain, thin and cut by hand.

empire-line-dress.name: Empire line dress
empire-line-dress.thesis: After the Revolution, a dress drops the hoop and the stays and shows a light, straight line from a waist under the bust.

english-bespoke-tailoring.name: English bespoke tailoring
english-bespoke-tailoring.thesis: A man's suit is drafted for one body, built inside with canvas, and shown outside by a plain surface and a line with no fuss.

victorian-sentimental-jewellery.name: Victorian Sentimental Jewellery
victorian-sentimental-jewellery.thesis: A jewel carries a memory: it holds a lock of hair, a name or a likeness close to the body.

victorian-corsetry.name: Victorian Corsetry
victorian-corsetry.thesis: The dress is only as good as the foundation: a firm, shaped corset gives the hourglass that the outer cloth then covers.

victorian-millinery.name: Victorian millinery
victorian-millinery.thesis: A hat completes a lady's dress, and the trim shows the skill of the milliner.

american-pocket-watch.name: American pocket watch
american-pocket-watch.thesis: A watch is a public tool. Each part is made to a gauge, the face is clear and the case lasts for decades.

victorian-boot.name: Victorian boot
victorian-boot.thesis: A Victorian woman covers the ankle, so the boot is the shoe of every day and the cloth upper shows the cut of the last.

malletier-luggage.name: Malletier luggage
malletier-luggage.thesis: A trunk is a small room that a traveller trusts, and each part of it serves a use.

crinoline-and-bustle-dress.name: Crinoline and bustle dress
crinoline-and-bustle-dress.thesis: The skirt is the dress: a steel cage and then a bustle carry yards of silk, and the couture house sets the shape each season.

country-sporting-tweed.name: Country sporting tweed
country-sporting-tweed.thesis: Dress for the weather, and put the sport first. A thick wool twill sheds rain, hides dirt and blends with heather, so it does the work of a coat. Age makes it better.

english-welted-dress-shoe.name: English welted dress shoe
english-welted-dress-shoe.thesis: A dress shoe lasts decades when its sole is welted and the upper is fine calf, so the shoe is a quiet sign of care.

americana-workwear.name: Americana workwear
americana-workwear.thesis: Work dress earns its form by use. Each seam, pocket and rivet answers a failure that the worker met, and the garment looks better when it is old.

brass-era-car.name: Brass-Era Car
brass-era-car.thesis: The first car is a carriage that has lost its horse. It keeps the wood, the leather and the brass of the coach. It shows its engine as a proud machine.

arts-and-crafts-jewellery.name: Arts and Crafts Jewellery
arts-and-crafts-jewellery.thesis: A jewel is a piece of craft. The maker's hand, a modest metal and a soft stone count for more than the weight of the gold.

art-nouveau-jewellery.name: Art Nouveau Jewellery
art-nouveau-jewellery.thesis: A jewel is a work of art: the design, the enamel and the line count for more than the value of the diamonds.

straight-front-corset.name: Straight-Front Corset
straight-front-corset.thesis: A corset that is cut straight in front and low on the bust is healthier and gives the new S-shaped line of 1900.

garland-style-jewellery.name: Garland Style Jewellery
garland-style-jewellery.thesis: A jewel is as light and as white as lace: platinum is so strong that the metal can almost disappear and leave only the stones.

early-wristwatch.name: Early wristwatch
early-wristwatch.thesis: Time must be on the wrist, where a pilot, a soldier or a driver can read it with one glance and no free hand.

bandeau-brassiere.name: Bandeau Brassiere
bandeau-brassiere.thesis: The body needs a light band, not a cage: a soft brassiere carries the bust and leaves the waist free for the new, loose dress.

trench-and-field-military.name: Trench and field military
trench-and-field-military.thesis: A uniform earns each strap, flap and pocket from a task in the mud: keep the rain out, carry the kit, and show rank.

art-deco-watch.name: Art Deco watch
art-deco-watch.thesis: A watch is a piece of jewellery with a plan. It has straight lines, black and white, and a rich metal, with no curve that has no job.

canvas-court-sneaker.name: Canvas court sneaker
canvas-court-sneaker.thesis: A court shoe is cheap cloth on a cured rubber sole, so it grips the floor and costs little; its plainness is the style.

vintage-coachbuilt-car.name: Vintage Coachbuilt Car
vintage-coachbuilt-car.thesis: A fine car is two works. The maker builds the chassis. The coachbuilder makes the body and the cabin to the taste of one buyer.

art-deco-dance-shoe.name: Art Deco dance shoe
art-deco-dance-shoe.thesis: A dancing woman needs a shoe that stays on the foot, so the strap holds the instep and the Deco pattern shows in every step.

early-mountaineering.name: Early mountaineering
early-mountaineering.thesis: Warmth comes from many thin layers, and wind is the enemy. The climber wears wool next to the skin and one tight cotton shell on top.

garconne-flapper-dress.name: Garçonne and flapper dress
garconne-flapper-dress.thesis: After the war, a woman's dress drops the corset and the waist, and a straight, short, easy line lets her work and dance.

costume-jewellery.name: Costume Jewellery
costume-jewellery.thesis: A jewel is an accessory to the outfit: it need not be real, because the effect counts for more than the value.

art-deco-evening-accessory.name: Art Deco evening accessory
art-deco-evening-accessory.thesis: An evening accessory is a jewel that holds a powder compact, and its geometry shows modern taste.

art-deco-jewellery.name: Art Deco Jewellery
art-deco-jewellery.thesis: A jewel is a machine-age design: a hard, flat pattern of line, angle and contrast in white metal and stones.

bias-cut-glamour.name: Bias-cut glamour
bias-cut-glamour.thesis: Silk cut across the grain drapes by itself, so that the body shows a line with no boning and no pads.

pilot-and-field-watch.name: Pilot and field watch
pilot-and-field-watch.thesis: A tool watch must be read at a glance, in poor light and with a glove on. Each part serves legibility and nothing else.

streamline-car.name: Streamline Car
streamline-car.thesis: A fast car looks like a drop of water: one smooth shell with no break in the line, from the grille to the tail.

modern-mens-briefs.name: Modern Men's Briefs
modern-mens-briefs.thesis: A man's underwear gives support and freedom of movement. A short knitted brief with a sewn-in waist is better than a loose drawer or a long suit.

retro-cocktail-jewellery.name: Retro Cocktail Jewellery
retro-cocktail-jewellery.thesis: A jewel is a bold, warm sculpture in gold: large, curved forms and bright coloured stones that gain from the dress and the cocktail hour.

quilted-down-outerwear.name: Quilted down outerwear
quilted-down-outerwear.thesis: Warmth comes from trapped air. Sew the down into baffles that stop it from sliding, and the jacket gives the most heat for the least weight.

mid-century-eyewear.name: Mid-century eyewear
mid-century-eyewear.thesis: Glasses are a part of the face, and the frame gives the wearer a character.

modernist-studio-jewellery.name: Modernist Studio Jewellery
modernist-studio-jewellery.thesis: A jewel is a small sculpture. An artist makes it by hand from an idea about form, and the metal and the stones serve the idea.

italian-gran-turismo.name: Italian Gran Turismo
italian-gran-turismo.thesis: A fine car is a sculpture that has a purpose. A taut, light body with no extra line, made by a carrozzeria around a fast engine.

new-look.name: New Look
new-look.thesis: After rationing, a woman's dress shows plenty: a small waist, a full skirt and the hand work of the couture house.

nylon-foundation-garments.name: Nylon Foundation Garments
nylon-foundation-garments.thesis: The post-war dress needs a built body under it, and nylon and elastic make that build light, washable and soft to wear.

tailfin-era-car.name: Tailfin-Era Car
tailfin-era-car.thesis: After the war a car shows plenty: each year it is longer, lower and brighter, with a fin and chrome that copy the jet aircraft.

ivy-style.name: Ivy style
ivy-style.thesis: A man's dress is plain, a little worn and made to last; it shows that he belongs and does not show that he tries.

dive-watch.name: Dive watch
dive-watch.thesis: A diver's life depends on a clear dial and a sealed case. The watch trades slimness for a dial that is easy to read in the dark and under pressure.

stiletto-heel.name: Stiletto heel
stiletto-heel.thesis: A thin steel-cored heel lifts the heel and lengthens the leg, so the shoe is about line, balance and the arch of the foot.

ladylike-handbag.name: Ladylike handbag
ladylike-handbag.thesis: A lady's bag completes her outfit, and it is small, firm and kept in order.

racing-chronograph.name: Racing chronograph
racing-chronograph.thesis: A racing chronograph is a stopwatch on the wrist. Its dial shows elapsed time and average speed in one glance, and the case stays slim enough to fit under a cuff.

brutalist-jewellery.name: Brutalist Jewellery
brutalist-jewellery.thesis: A jewel is a raw object: a rough surface and an uncut stone show the real material and refuse the polish of the old shop.

mod-and-mini.name: Mod and mini
mod-and-mini.thesis: Fashion belongs to the young and the street: a short hem, a clean cut and a bold print show speed and fun.

nordic-functional-outdoor.name: Nordic functional outdoor
nordic-functional-outdoor.thesis: Dress for a day out in all weather. Simple shapes, tough cloth that can be waxed and mended, and layers that serve the walker for a lifetime.

subculture-workboot.name: Subculture workboot
subculture-workboot.thesis: A work boot on a young foot is a signal of class and group. It is heavy, plain, cheap and hard to damage. The owner wears it to show that he or she belongs.

muscle-and-pony-car.name: Muscle and Pony Car
muscle-and-pony-car.thesis: A fast car is for the young and must cost little. It has a long bonnet over a big engine, a short tail and a few bold marks, on a small base.

soft-natural-lingerie.name: Soft Natural Lingerie
soft-natural-lingerie.thesis: Underwear should follow the body and not shape it: a soft cup, a thin cloth and a skin tone that shows no line.

space-age-couture.name: Space Age couture
space-age-couture.thesis: Dress for the future shows clean, geometric lines and new materials. The body moves free in a short, flat, hard-edged shape of white, silver and plastic.

hippie-bohemian-dress.name: Hippie bohemian dress
hippie-bohemian-dress.thesis: Dress is free of the factory and of the rules of the shop: handmade, worldly, loose on the body and rich in colour.

wedge-design-car.name: Wedge Design Car
wedge-design-car.thesis: A fast car cuts the air as a blade does. It has one straight line from a low nose to a high tail, with flat panels and sharp creases.

electronic-and-digital-watch.name: Electronic and digital watch
electronic-and-digital-watch.thesis: A watch is an electronic instrument, so it shows the time as digits. A crystal with no moving parts keeps the time.

glam-platform-shoe.name: Glam platform shoe
glam-platform-shoe.thesis: A glam shoe adds height and noise: a thick platform and a bright upper make the wearer taller, louder and not quite real.

luxury-steel-sports-watch.name: Luxury steel sports watch
luxury-steel-sports-watch.thesis: Steel can be luxury if the maker finishes it like gold, so the price comes from the hand work, not from the metal.

performance-running-shoe.name: Performance running shoe
performance-running-shoe.thesis: A running shoe is a tool. Every part, from the weight to the heel height, is set by the way the foot lands and the number of kilometres it runs.

punk-fashion.name: Punk fashion
punk-fashion.thesis: Dress is a protest that the wearer makes by hand: the garment is torn, pinned and written on, and it shocks on purpose.

technical-shell-alpinism.name: Technical shell alpinism
technical-shell-alpinism.thesis: A shell must stop rain and let sweat out. A membrane with pores that block water and pass vapour, seams that are sealed, and a cut that moves with the climber.

power-dressing.name: Power dressing
power-dressing.thesis: Dress is a uniform of authority. A woman at work wears the wide shoulder and the sharp line of the man's suit, and so claims the same standing.

streetwear.name: Streetwear
streetwear.thesis: Dress comes from the street and the club: the wearer joins a group by a plain, comfortable garment that carries a mark.

japanese-avant-garde-fashion.name: Japanese avant-garde fashion
japanese-avant-garde-fashion.thesis: A garment is a space around the body, not a copy of it: it can be loose, torn, uneven and black, and still be beautiful.

designer-logo-underwear.name: Designer Logo Underwear
designer-logo-underwear.thesis: A basic garment gains value from its maker's name: the plain brief stays plain, and the label on the band carries the brand.

swiss-plastic-pop-watch.name: Swiss plastic pop watch
swiss-plastic-pop-watch.thesis: A watch can be a fashion accessory that one wears for a season. The maker sells colour and a pattern at a price that allows many watches.

underwear-as-outerwear.name: Underwear as Outerwear
underwear-as-outerwear.thesis: What was hidden is now the dress: a corset, a bra or a slip shown in the open gives the body a built, public form.

logomania.name: Logomania
logomania.thesis: The mark of the maker is the ornament, and the wearer shows a place in the world by it.

sneaker-culture.name: Sneaker culture
sneaker-culture.thesis: In this style the shoe is a signal: colour, release and story matter more than function, and an owner shows taste by what is rare.

biodesign-car.name: Biodesign Car
biodesign-car.thesis: A car for everyday life has the forms of a plant or an animal. It is round, smooth and friendly, with no hard edge and no sign of a machine.

minimalist-fashion.name: Minimalist fashion
minimalist-fashion.thesis: After the show of the 1980s, dress is plain: a perfect cut in fine cloth needs no ornament.

it-bag.name: It bag
it-bag.thesis: A single bag can carry the whole fashion of a season, and its scarcity is part of its design.

retro-revival-car.name: Retro Revival Car
retro-revival-car.thesis: A new car can borrow the face of a loved old one. It must keep the key shapes and add the comfort and safety of today.

shapewear-and-seamless.name: Shapewear and Seamless
shapewear-and-seamless.thesis: Shaping can be soft: a knit with elastane holds the body without bone and leaves no line under the cloth.

techwear.name: Techwear
techwear.thesis: The city is a hard environment. Dress for it as for a mountain, with a shell, a system of pockets and straps, and a black, sealed surface.

quiet-luxury-fashion.name: Quiet luxury fashion
quiet-luxury-fashion.thesis: Real luxury is quiet. It shows in the touch of the cloth and the fit of the cut, and only a person who knows will see it.

stealth-luxury-accessory.name: Stealth luxury accessory
stealth-luxury-accessory.thesis: True luxury has no mark: the quality of the material and the work is the only sign.

electric-minimal-car.name: Electric Minimal Car
electric-minimal-car.thesis: An electric car has no engine to show. It is a smooth, quiet shell with a bare cabin, and a screen holds all of the controls.

smartwatch.name: Smartwatch
smartwatch.thesis: A watch is the screen on the wrist. It shows the time, messages and health data. The user changes the face as often as a shirt.

gorpcore.name: Gorpcore
gorpcore.thesis: The best dress is the kind you would take on a hike: it looks plain, it is tough, and its colours come from the trail.

jomon-pottery.name: Jōmon pottery
jomon-pottery.thesis: A pot is a coiled and fired form that carries the marks of its making: the cord, the cut and the clay itself are the ornament.

greek-black-figure.name: Greek black-figure pottery
greek-black-figure.thesis: A pot is a surface for story: black silhouettes on red clay, made sharp with incised lines, tell a myth in frieze after frieze.

babylonian-glazed-brick.name: Babylonian glazed brick
babylonian-glazed-brick.thesis: A mud-brick city wall becomes a royal image when each brick is moulded, glazed blue and fired, so that the animals of the gods stand in a row along the road.

greek-red-figure.name: Greek red-figure pottery
greek-red-figure.thesis: A vase is a field for the drawn human body: the figure stays the colour of the clay and the brush line gives it weight, movement and feeling.

qin-terracotta-warriors.name: Qin terracotta warriors
qin-terracotta-warriors.thesis: An emperor takes an army of clay into the grave, and a factory system of standard parts and hand finish makes each soldier a different man.

roman-terra-sigillata.name: Roman terra sigillata
roman-terra-sigillata.thesis: A fine slip, not a glaze, gives the red shine: the potter sorts the clay by particle size, paints the thin top layer on the pot, and fires it in clean air.

tang-sancai-figures.name: Tang sancai figures
tang-sancai-figures.thesis: A tomb figure shows the luxury of the living court in clay, and a lead glaze in three colours makes the animal or the lady glow.

abbasid-lustreware.name: Abbasid lustreware
abbasid-lustreware.thesis: A cheap clay pot can shine like metal when a white tin glaze and a thin film of reduced silver and copper turn into a mirror of gold.

ding-white-ware.name: Ding white ware
ding-white-ware.thesis: A white body and a clear ivory glaze are enough: the beauty is the thin wall, the carved line and the quiet tone.

jian-tenmoku-ware.name: Jian tenmoku ware
jian-tenmoku-ware.thesis: A bowl for whisked white tea must be dark, so that the foam shows; the kiln, not the brush, makes the pattern in an iron-rich glaze.

goryeo-celadon.name: Goryeo celadon
goryeo-celadon.thesis: A pot is a clear green lens over a drawing: the glaze is almost transparent and the inlaid slip line shows through it like ink in water.

longquan-celadon.name: Longquan celadon
longquan-celadon.thesis: A vessel reaches beauty when the glaze alone makes it: a thick, quiet green like jade that hides all other ornament.

islamic-tile-mosaic.name: Islamic tile mosaic
islamic-tile-mosaic.thesis: A building surface becomes a woven pattern of light and colour when many small tiles in turquoise, cobalt and black are cut to fit one geometric plan.

hispano-moresque-lustreware.name: Hispano-Moresque lustreware
hispano-moresque-lustreware.thesis: A plain earthenware dish can serve a king when a white glaze, a gold lustre and a heraldic crest cover it in one dense pattern.

zellige.name: Zellige
zellige.thesis: Hand-cut pieces of one-colour glazed clay make a pattern that is exact in its geometry and alive in its surface.

yuan-ming-blue-and-white.name: Yuan and Ming blue-and-white porcelain
yuan-ming-blue-and-white.thesis: Cobalt blue painted straight on white porcelain and sealed under a clear glaze gives a lasting picture that cannot rub or fade.

joseon-buncheong.name: Joseon buncheong
joseon-buncheong.thesis: A plain grey stoneware gains life when a white slip is brushed, stamped or carved on it by a free hand with no fear of the rough.

rhenish-salt-glaze-stoneware.name: Rhenish salt-glaze stoneware
rhenish-salt-glaze-stoneware.thesis: A dense stoneware pot needs no lining, because a handful of salt thrown into the hot kiln gives it a skin that keeps out water and does not taste of lead.

liuli-glazed-roof.name: Liuli glazed roof tile
liuli-glazed-roof.thesis: A roof tile is a sign of rank: its colour, its ridge figures and its curved line tell the viewer which hall is for the emperor.

della-robbia-relief.name: Della Robbia relief
della-robbia-relief.thesis: Sculpture in clay becomes lasting and bright when a white tin glaze covers it, so that a church relief shines and resists rain like marble.

albarello-apothecary-ware.name: Albarello apothecary ware
albarello-apothecary-ware.thesis: A drug jar must tell a clerk which drug it holds, so the label is part of the pot: a painted cartouche on a clean white tin glaze.

iznik-pottery.name: Iznik pottery
iznik-pottery.thesis: A bright garden of flowers can be painted flat and sharp on a white body, and it stays fresh under a clear glass-like glaze.

istoriato-maiolica.name: Istoriato maiolica
istoriato-maiolica.thesis: A dish can be a painting: the whole surface becomes a scene of myth, scripture or history, painted in many colours on white tin glaze.

yixing-zisha-teapot.name: Yixing zisha teapot
yixing-zisha-teapot.thesis: A teapot for steeped tea needs no glaze: a dense, porous clay keeps the tea hot and the taste pure, and the pot improves with use.

iznik-tiles.name: Iznik tiles
iznik-tiles.thesis: A court tile is a garden in glaze: the painter shows tulips, carnations and leaves in clear colours on a white ground, and the glaze gives them depth.

azulejo.name: Azulejo
azulejo.thesis: A wall becomes a picture when many square tiles are painted as one scene on a white tin glaze.

kraak-porcelain.name: Kraak porcelain
kraak-porcelain.thesis: One cobalt blue on a white porcelain body, ordered in panels that a quick painter can repeat, makes a pattern that a whole continent wants to buy.

mino-tea-ceramics.name: Mino tea ceramics
mino-tea-ceramics.thesis: Japanese potters of the Momoyama period make their own tea ware: thick glaze, free brush and a form that is bent on purpose.

raku-tea-bowl.name: Raku tea bowl
raku-tea-bowl.thesis: A tea bowl need not be thrown, round or bright: hand-built, a little uneven and fired fast, it can calm the mind and ask nothing of the eye.

delft-tiles.name: Delft tiles
delft-tiles.thesis: A cheap square tile and a quick brush make a clean, washable wall that still holds a small picture in each unit.

delftware.name: Delftware
delftware.thesis: A cheap local clay looks like Chinese porcelain when a white tin glaze covers it and a fast brush paints it in cobalt blue.

joseon-moon-jar.name: Joseon moon jar
joseon-moon-jar.thesis: A form that is round and nearly empty, white and warm, can hold more than a painted jar because it shows the breath of its making.

kyo-yaki-overglaze.name: Kyo-yaki overglaze
kyo-yaki-overglaze.thesis: A Kyoto potter can make tea ware as rich as a screen painting: a thin body, a pale crackle glaze, enamel and gold.

kakiemon-imari-export.name: Kakiemon and Imari export porcelain
kakiemon-imari-export.thesis: A white porcelain can carry two styles of decoration: a spare picture in the open white, and a crowded design in blue, red and gold.

english-slipware.name: English slipware
english-slipware.thesis: A country potter needs no costly colour: red clay, white slip from a quill, and a lead glaze give a bold picture.

famille-rose-qing.name: Famille rose (Qing)
famille-rose-qing.thesis: A white porcelain glaze takes opaque enamel like a canvas, and a pink from gold lets the painter model soft flesh, petals and clouds.

meissen-baroque-porcelain.name: Meissen baroque porcelain
