meissen-baroque-porcelain.thesis: Once Europe can make porcelain, it shows the fact: a white body that is modelled in a sculptural mass and painted in every enamel colour.

rococo-porcelain-figures.name: Rococo porcelain figures
rococo-porcelain-figures.thesis: A porcelain figure is a toy for the table of a prince: white, glossy and light, it turns a scene of court play into a small, bright piece of theatre.

georgian-porcelain-tea-service.name: Georgian porcelain tea service
georgian-porcelain-tea-service.thesis: English potters make a full tea table in porcelain for the new tea drinkers: a set of matched pieces, with a Chinese or a European look.

staffordshire-figures.name: Staffordshire figures
staffordshire-figures.thesis: A figure for every mantelpiece comes from a plaster mould and a clear glaze: flat, bold and cheap, it puts a hero, a king or a dog in a poor man's house.

scandinavian-tiled-stove.name: Scandinavian tiled stove
scandinavian-tiled-stove.thesis: A white tiled stove is both a machine for heat and a piece of furniture: the glaze reflects the light of a dark northern room.

biscuit-porcelain-figures.name: Biscuit porcelain figures
biscuit-porcelain-figures.thesis: When the glaze and the colour are gone, only the form is left, so that a porcelain figure can look like fine marble in the hand.

sevres-rococo-porcelain.name: Sèvres rococo porcelain
sevres-rococo-porcelain.thesis: A soft, glassy body takes a deep, even ground colour that no hard paste can match; the painter then leaves white windows for the flowers.

creamware-neoclassical.name: Creamware, neoclassical
creamware-neoclassical.thesis: A light cream body and a clear glaze, in a plain classical form, outsell both porcelain and delftware, because the whole service is cheap, even and easy to match.

mocha-banded-ware.name: Mocha and banded ware
mocha-banded-ware.thesis: A machine can turn the bands of a dipped jug in one pass, and one drop of acid colour on a wet slip makes a tree that no hand can plan.

jasperware-neoclassical.name: Jasperware (Neoclassical)
jasperware-neoclassical.thesis: A matt coloured stoneware with white Greek and Roman reliefs lets an English factory make the antique world for the library table.

blue-willow-transferware.name: Blue willow transferware
blue-willow-transferware.thesis: A copper plate puts a Chinese-style blue picture on cheap white earthenware, so that every household owns the pattern that once only a rich house could buy.

american-stoneware-crock.name: American stoneware crock
american-stoneware-crock.thesis: A crock must hold butter, pickles or pork for a winter, so the body is dense stoneware and the only ornament is one quick blue brush stroke.

regency-gilded-bone-china.name: Regency gilded bone china
regency-gilded-bone-china.thesis: Bone ash gives English potters a strong, white and warm body at a fair price, and they cover it in colour and gold to match the rich rooms of the Regency.

spongeware.name: Spongeware
spongeware.thesis: A sponge turns a cheap white pot into a coloured one in a few seconds, so that a worker without training can decorate a hundred pieces in an hour.

victorian-encaustic-tiles.name: Victorian encaustic tiles
victorian-encaustic-tiles.thesis: A pattern that is part of the clay, and not a layer on it, does not wear off under a million feet.

parian-statuary.name: Parian statuary
parian-statuary.thesis: Fine sculpture comes into the Victorian parlour when a white porcelain slip is cast in a mould and fired without a glaze: marble, but small and cheap.

porcelain-insulator.name: Porcelain insulator
porcelain-insulator.thesis: A wire needs a dry, hard, glazed surface between it and the earth, so the clay body is dense and the shape is a stack of rain skirts.

victorian-architectural-terracotta.name: Victorian architectural terracotta
victorian-architectural-terracotta.thesis: A smoky industrial city needs a facade that rain can wash: a glazed or hard-fired clay block gives rich ornament at a price that a mason cannot meet.

victorian-sanitary-ware.name: Victorian sanitary ware
victorian-sanitary-ware.thesis: A new sanitary fitting must look like fine china, so that a family sees a clean, rich object in a room that was once hidden.

arts-and-crafts-art-pottery.name: Arts and Crafts art pottery
arts-and-crafts-art-pottery.thesis: A pot is a work of art when one person makes it from clay and glaze, and the hand is allowed to show.

american-art-pottery.name: American art pottery
american-art-pottery.thesis: A pottery of artists can make a vase a painting or a leaf: one line paints in slip under glaze, and the other line builds the form in matt colour.

fireclay-butler-sink.name: Fireclay butler sink
fireclay-butler-sink.thesis: A kitchen sink must be deep, heavy and glazed so hard that a pot, a brush and boiling water do not mark it.

chicago-school-terracotta.name: Chicago School terracotta
chicago-school-terracotta.thesis: When a steel frame carries the load, the wall becomes a skin: a thin clay tile protects the steel from fire and carries the ornament.

art-nouveau-ceramics.name: Art Nouveau ceramics
art-nouveau-ceramics.thesis: A vase grows like a plant: its form follows one living curve, and the glaze flows over it in deep colour.

hungarian-secession-ceramics.name: Hungarian Secession ceramics
hungarian-secession-ceramics.thesis: A national style needs a national material: frost-proof, bright clay tiles with Hungarian folk flowers and Eastern patterns make a roof into the face of a building.

art-nouveau-tiles.name: Art Nouveau tiles
art-nouveau-tiles.thesis: A factory tile can carry the line of a plant, if the mould and the glaze do the drawing.

trencadis.name: Trencadís
trencadis.thesis: A broken tile is not waste: a wall of shards takes any curve, and the glaze colour of each piece joins into one bright surface.

subway-tile.name: Subway tile
subway-tile.thesis: A white, shiny, small tile makes a wall that is clean, bright and easy to wash.

anglo-oriental-studio-pottery.name: Anglo-Oriental studio pottery
anglo-oriental-studio-pottery.thesis: A good pot joins the plain beauty of East Asian stoneware with the English craft of one person who makes, glazes and fires it.

suprematist-porcelain.name: Suprematist porcelain
suprematist-porcelain.thesis: A pot is a Suprematist object when its form is built of cylinders, cubes and slabs, and the paint on it is a flat plane of colour.

cornishware.name: Cornishware
cornishware.thesis: A kitchen set looks right when every piece carries the same four blue stripes on white, so the shelf reads as one plain family.

art-deco-ceramic-figures.name: Art Deco ceramic figures
art-deco-ceramic-figures.thesis: The modern woman, the dancer and the fast animal are stylised into long lines and flat planes, then cast in clay and painted in hard, bright colours.

art-deco-faience-facade.name: Art Deco faience facade
art-deco-faience-facade.thesis: A glazed, washable slab turns a commercial building into a bright sign: colour and geometry attract the eye from the street.

mingei-folk-craft.name: Mingei folk craft
mingei-folk-craft.thesis: The most beautiful pots are the plain tools of daily life that anonymous craftspeople make in large numbers, with local clay and no wish for fame.

coloured-bathroom-suite.name: Coloured bathroom suite
coloured-bathroom-suite.thesis: Sanitary ware can be a colour of the room, and one even glaze on every piece makes a bathroom that matches.

art-deco-tableware.name: Art Deco tableware
art-deco-tableware.thesis: A cheap white earthenware becomes modern when a painter puts strong flat colour in sharp geometry on a form with angles and cones.

bauhaus-modern-tableware.name: Bauhaus modern tableware
bauhaus-modern-tableware.thesis: A service is a tool for the table: it is a few simple solids, in white, that fit one another and give good use.

fiesta-colourware.name: Fiesta colourware
fiesta-colourware.thesis: One simple, ringed shape in a set of strong glaze colours lets every buyer build a table of their own, one piece at a time.

organic-modern-tableware.name: Organic modern tableware
organic-modern-tableware.thesis: A table set is easy to live with when its forms flow like pebbles and its colours are the quiet colours of stone, leaf and sand.

british-modernist-studio.name: British modernist studio ceramics
british-modernist-studio.thesis: A modern pot is a precise form with a quiet surface, where the glaze and the clay do the work that ornament did before.

artist-ceramics-vallauris.name: Artist ceramics of Vallauris
artist-ceramics-vallauris.thesis: A painter treats the potter's vase as a body and the plate as a canvas, and plays with the craft in a joyful, quick and plain way.

scandinavian-modern-tableware.name: Scandinavian modern tableware
scandinavian-modern-tableware.thesis: A few plain shapes that stack, a warm satin glaze and a quiet hand mark make tableware that is made in a factory but feels human.

abstract-expressionist-ceramics.name: Abstract Expressionist ceramics
abstract-expressionist-ceramics.thesis: The pot is a place for a gesture: a thrown cylinder can be cut, torn and stacked like paint on a canvas, and the use of the vessel no longer sets the form.

glass-ceramic-cookware.name: Glass-ceramic cookware
glass-ceramic-cookware.thesis: A cook wants one pot that goes from the freezer to the flame to the table, so the body is a glass that heat turns into a fine crystal ceramic.

west-german-fat-lava.name: West German fat lava
west-german-fat-lava.thesis: A thick glaze that is allowed to run, bubble and crater gives a mass-made vase the look of cooled volcanic rock.

funk-ceramics.name: Funk ceramics
funk-ceramics.thesis: Clay is a rude, funny material, so a sculptor can make a toilet, a typewriter or a bust of himself and treat high art as a joke.

large-format-porcelain-tiles.name: Large-format porcelain tiles
large-format-porcelain-tiles.thesis: One large, dense, thin sheet of ceramic makes a seamless surface that holds the look of another material.

washlet-toilet.name: Washlet toilet
washlet-toilet.thesis: A toilet is a clean machine for the body, so the ceramic stays smooth and the seat adds water, heat and control.

memphis-postmodern-ceramics.name: Memphis postmodern ceramics
memphis-postmodern-ceramics.thesis: A vase is a toy, a totem and a joke at the same time: its form is a stack of simple solids, and its surface is a pattern in loud colour.

terracotta-rainscreen.name: Terracotta rainscreen
terracotta-rainscreen.thesis: A wall of fired clay can be a light, ventilated skin: the panel keeps the rain from the insulation, and the air behind it dries the wall.

designer-wall-hung-sanitary.name: Designer wall-hung sanitary ware
designer-wall-hung-sanitary.thesis: A bathroom fitting is a designed object, so the ceramic has a clear, simple shape that floats off the floor.

chef-studio-tableware.name: Chef studio tableware
chef-studio-tableware.thesis: A chef and a potter design the plate with the dish: a matt, earthy and slightly uneven vessel gives the food a ground that no factory plate can give.

digital-3d-printed-ceramics.name: Digital 3D-printed ceramics
digital-3d-printed-ceramics.thesis: When a machine builds the form from a file, the vessel can have a shape that no wheel or mould can make, and the layer line becomes the ornament.

medieval-court-cuisine.name: Medieval court cuisine
medieval-court-cuisine.thesis: Make the table show rank: use costly spices, bright colour and many dishes at once, and let each sauce mix sweet, sour and hot.

renaissance-banquet.name: Renaissance banquet
renaissance-banquet.thesis: Show the power of the host with the number, the skill and the beauty of the dishes, and let sugar and pastry take the shape of buildings and beasts.

cuisine-francoise.name: Cuisine françoise
cuisine-francoise.thesis: Cook for the taste of the food itself: build each sauce on a stock and a roux, and use herbs where the medieval kitchen used spice.

grande-cuisine.name: Grande cuisine
grande-cuisine.thesis: Make cooking an art of order and show: a system of sauces on the stove, and architecture of sugar and pastry on the table.

cuisine-classique.name: Cuisine classique
cuisine-classique.thesis: Simplify Carême and make the kitchen a system: every dish comes from a small set of bases, cooked by a station that does one task.

haute-regionale.name: Haute cuisine régionale
haute-regionale.thesis: Cook the classic dish well with the best produce of the region, on a short menu, and make the restaurant a place of travel.

nouvelle-cuisine.name: Nouvelle cuisine
nouvelle-cuisine.thesis: Take the weight out of Escoffier: fresh market produce, short cooking and a sauce without flour let the taste of the ingredient lead.

california-cuisine.name: California cuisine
california-cuisine.thesis: The best cooking starts with the best produce: buy ripe food from known growers in season, and then do as little to it as you can.

cuisine-minceur.name: Cuisine minceur
cuisine-minceur.thesis: A dish can be low in fat and sugar and still be haute cuisine, if the cook uses exact technique and fresh produce in place of butter and cream.

naturalist-cuisine.name: Naturalist cuisine
naturalist-cuisine.thesis: The land around the kitchen is the pantry and the teacher: the cook walks it, learns each plant in each week, and cooks only what the walk gives.

pacific-rim-fusion.name: Pacific Rim fusion
pacific-rim-fusion.thesis: A chef from one tradition can use the pantry and the flavours of another, if the cook keeps the balance of each dish and the precision of the technique.

novoandina-and-nikkei.name: Novoandina and Nikkei cuisine
novoandina-and-nikkei.thesis: Peru holds the sea, the desert, the mountain and the jungle, and the cooks of Lima join them with the knives of Japan and the sauces of France to make one new national kitchen.

molecular-gastronomy.name: Molecular gastronomy
molecular-gastronomy.thesis: Cooks can ask why food changes when it is heated, mixed or frozen, and then use the answer to build new textures, temperatures and surprises.

bistronomie.name: Bistronomie
bistronomie.thesis: Good cooking does not need a palace: a trained chef can serve fine produce and exact technique in a simple room at a fair price.

modernist-cuisine.name: Modernist cuisine
modernist-cuisine.thesis: A cook who knows the physics of heat, water and texture can control the result to the degree, the second and the gram, and can then make food that was not possible before.

new-nordic.name: New Nordic cuisine
new-nordic.thesis: A kitchen of one place and one season: the cold, the short summer and the long winter of the North set the menu, and the cook preserves the summer for the winter.

plant-based-fine-dining.name: Plant-based fine dining
plant-based-fine-dining.thesis: The top of the table does not need an animal: with skill, time and ferments, a carrot, a beet or a nut can carry the weight that foie gras and beef once carried.
